column1: A bit of the Blacksmith Shop sign is visible from here. At least, you |c2|think|c| it's the Blacksmith's Shop. Either that or somebody erected a store called "ACKS" while you weren't looking.
column2: 從這裡可以看到鐵匠鋪招牌的一角。至少，你|c2|認為|c|那是鐵匠鋪。不然就是有人趁你不注意，開了一間叫「ACKS」的店。

column1: You can't possibly reach it from here!
column2: 你不可能從這裡搆到它！

column2: 醒醒吧。

column2: 山姆安德列亞斯當舖的金球招牌就在……就是……在那兒，土路盡頭，鐵軌對面。

column1: You'll have to go over to Main Street if you want to do that.
column2: 你得去大街那邊才能做那件事。

column1: You can kinda see the front of Mom's Cafe from here. It's the only 1-and-a-half star dining experience in the entire San Jokin' Valley!
column2: 你勉強可以從這裡看到老媽餐館的正面。這可是整個聖笑金山谷唯一一家「一顆半星」等級的用餐體驗！

column1: In your dreams.
column2: 你想得美。

column1: It's the lovely and winsome Chastity, a girl who really knows her stuff! In fact, every man in town knows her stuff!
column2: 是可愛迷人的貞潔，一個很懂門道的姑娘！事實上，鎮上每個男人都懂她的門道！

column1: Howdy, Chastity!
column2: 哈囉，貞潔！

column1: Howdy to you, you big ol' sloppy hunka manly macho woman-lovin' man!
column2: 哈囉啊，你這個邋遢豪邁、渾身肌肉、愛死女人的男子漢！

column1: Layin' it on a little thick tonight, aren't we?
column2: 今晚馬屁拍得有點過火啊，是吧？

column2: 是啊，生意清淡，但我總得保持手感。

column1: Oooh, Freddy! When you touch me, I get all weird inside!
column2: 噢，佛萊迪！你一碰我，我心裡就變得怪怪的！

column1: Hope you mean it!
column2: 希望你是真心的！

column1: That's Purity. She's 99 44/100ths percent impure... but she still floats!
column2: 那是純潔。她有百分之九十九點四四不純潔……但照樣浮得起來！

column1: Evening, Purity!
column2: 晚安啊，純潔！

column1: Evening, Freddy! Has Madame still got you under lock 'n' key, or are you gonna let us get ahold of you one of these days?
column2: 晚安，佛萊迪！歐薇莉夫人還把你鎖得死死的嗎？還是哪天你會讓我們也抓到你？

column1: I'm afraid I'm all hers, for the time being.
column2: 恐怕目前我整個人都是她的。

column1: Well, if you ever change your mind, honey... you know where to find us!
column2: 好吧，甜心，要是你哪天改變心意……你知道去哪裡找我們！

column1: (And when, and how often, and for how much!)
column2: （還有什麼時候、多常一次、還有多少錢！）

column1: You're such a handsome man! Girls like me really go for men like you!
column2: 你真是個帥哥！像我這樣的姑娘就愛你這種男人！

column1: It's Virtue, one of the Madame's best-laid plans.
column2: 是美德，歐薇莉夫人「精心安排」的傑作之一。

column1: Howdy, Miz Virtue! You sure are a vision of loveliness!
column2: 哈囉，美德小姐！你真是美得像一幅畫！

column1: Thank you ever so much, Freddy! And you, sir, are a study in buff!
column2: 太謝謝你了，佛萊迪！而你呢，先生，簡直是一身精壯的活教材！

column1: What does that mean?
column2: 那是什麼意思？

column1: Just that you're the manliest prescription-fillin' man I ever did see!
column2: 意思是你是我見過最有男子氣概的抓藥師傅！

column1: Thank you!
column2: 謝謝！

column1: The touch of your manly hand and the sight of your bulging muscles really brings out the raw animal passion in me!
column2: 你那雙男人的手一碰，還有看到你鼓起的肌肉，就讓我內心的野性激情整個被喚醒了！

column1: What she really means is, the sight of a manly bulging WALLET really brings out the raw animal passion in her!
column2: 她真正的意思是，看到一個鼓得飽飽的男人「錢包」，才真的會喚醒她內心的野性激情！

column1: Hey, big boy! It's about time you showed up. Time to take my pharmacy bill out in trade?
column2: 嘿，大帥哥！你總算來了。要用「以物易物」來抵我的藥局帳單了嗎？

column1: <gulp> Sure!
column2: <倒抽一口氣> 好啊！

column1: Then get over here before I have to come get you, sweetie!
column2: 那就快過來，甜心，不然我可要親自去抓你囉！

column1: Right here in public??
column2: 就在這種大庭廣眾之下？？

column1: It's Olga, for those who don't want to spend another sheepless night!
column2: 這位是奧爾嘉，專門服務不想再過「無羊之夜」的人！

column1: Baa-aaa-aa-a!
column2: 咩－啊－啊－啊！

column2: （翻譯：妳到底怎麼收費？）

column1: Baa-aa baa-aaa!
column2: 咩－啊 咩－啊啊！

column2: （翻譯：我可是雙倍價錢的「羊」貨！）

column1: Ba-ba baa-baa!
column2: 巴－巴 咩－咩！

column2: （翻譯：聽起來很划算！）

(Translation: Yes, I cost next to mutton!)
column2: （翻譯：沒錯，我幾乎不值半點「羊」毛錢！）

column1: Ba-aa-aa-aa-aa!
column2: 巴－啊－啊－啊－啊！

column2: （翻譯：「哎呀，你這個人類長得真好看，手法也真溫柔！」）

column1: Ba-aa-aa baa-aah!
column2: 巴－啊－啊 咩－啊！

column2: （翻譯：「希望你是真心的！」）

column1: The room is a riot of plush red velvet. The girls are impatiently waiting for customers so that they can go upstairs and lie down awhile.
column2: 房間裡到處是華麗的紅色天鵝絨。姑娘們正不耐煩地等著客人上門，好上樓躺一會兒。

column1: The room is a riot of plush red velvet. The girls are upstairs, lying down. (This time, on their stomachs!)
column2: 房間裡到處是華麗的紅色天鵝絨。姑娘們都在樓上躺著。（這次是趴著的！）

column1: The plush walls effectively deaden the sound of your voice as you try to talk to the accoutrement.
column2: 這些華麗的牆壁把你對著擺設說話的聲音，吸得一乾二淨。

column1: You can't take the whole brothel, like the other customers you'll just have to take it one piece at a time.
column2: 你沒辦法把整間妓院都帶走，跟其他客人一樣，你只能一次來一點。

column1: From down here, that looks like a curtain of rich, crushed velour.
column2: 從下面看過去，那像是一幅華麗的縐絨窗簾。

column1: The curtain's upstairs, and you NEVER go upstairs at the Brothel! Madame insists on keeping you all to herself.
column2: 窗簾在樓上，而你「絕對」不能上妓院的樓！歐薇莉夫人堅持要把你整個人獨佔。

column1: The balustrade lends an opulent ambience to the brothel's ornamentation. (Shoot, where'd all them ten-dollar words come from?)
column2: 這欄杆為妓院的裝飾增添了一股奢華的氣息。（見鬼，這些文謅謅的大字眼是打哪冒出來的？）

column1: It's upstairs, and you can't reach it from here.
column2: 它在樓上，你從這裡搆不到。

column1: A splendid chandelier hangs in the center of the room.
column2: 一盞華麗的吊燈掛在房間正中央。

column1: You have a thing for swinging from chandeliers, eh?
column2: 你對盪吊燈這種事還挺有興趣的，嗯？

column1: It's a plush red velvet loveseat.
column2: 是一張華麗的紅色天鵝絨情人椅。

column1: You'd love to sit and chat, but you're not here for relaxation.
column2: 你是很想坐下來聊聊，但你來這裡不是為了放鬆。

column1: A couple of plush red velvet chairs have been strategically placed in the room so as to offer customers the girls' best profiles.
column2: 房間裡刻意擺了幾張華麗的紅色天鵝絨椅子，好讓客人能看到姑娘們最迷人的角度。

column1: You won't need any plush red velvet chairs in your quest for truth, justice, liberty, and a good time.
column2: 在你追求真理、正義、自由與歡樂時光的路上，用不著什麼華麗的紅色天鵝絨椅子。

column1: The windows and entryways are festooned with plush red velvet curtains. (Festooned: from the Latin "festus," to drawl in a southern accent and shlep around in a lazy fashion and just sort of drape yourself over furniture.)
column2: 窗戶和門口都掛滿了華麗的紅色天鵝絨窗簾。（「掛滿」一詞源自拉丁文「festus」，意思是拖著南方腔調懶洋洋地晃來晃去，然後隨便把自己攤在家具上。）

column1: You can't open or close them; they're nailed just the way they are, with sensuous curves and folds vaguely suggestive of female anatomy. Or Shar Pei puppies, depending on your point-of-view.
column2: 你沒辦法把它們打開或關上；它們就這樣被釘死，帶著性感的曲線與皺褶，隱約讓人聯想到女性的身體曲線。或者，看你怎麼想，也像沙皮狗幼犬。

column1: There's a handsome silver tea set on the coffee table. It stands out, since it's just about the only thing in the room that isn't plush red velvet!
column2: 咖啡桌上有一套精美的銀質茶具。它特別顯眼，因為這幾乎是房間裡唯一不是華麗紅色天鵝絨的東西！

column1: You prefer sarsaparilla, thank you very much. (In a cracked, dirty bottle.)
column2: 謝了，你比較想喝沙士。（裝在破舊骯髒的瓶子裡的那種。）

column1: The clock's pendulum swings constantly. Just like Madame's girls!
column2: 這座鐘的鐘擺不停地擺動。就跟歐薇莉夫人的姑娘們一樣！

column1: The clock never needs winding... just a little jiggle now and then.
column2: 這座鐘從不需要上發條……只要三不五時搖它一下就好。

column1: These cupids decorate the stair banister.
column2: 這些小愛神雕像裝飾著樓梯扶手。

column1: Aren't they just too too?
column2: 是不是可愛得不得了？

column1: A charming picture window looks out over the side of the house. The view's a little blurry, though, owing to all the slobber on the outside of the window.
column2: 一扇迷人的觀景窗望向屋子側面。不過視野有點模糊，因為窗外沾滿了口水。

column1: Madame's windows don't open. She doesn't want anyone chickening out at the last moment.
column2: 歐薇莉夫人的窗戶都打不開。她可不希望有人在最後關頭臨陣脫逃。

column1: A brass cuspidor, known as a "spittoon," sits next to the plush red velvet armchair. (Spittoons for FREDDY PHARKAS, FRONTIER PHARMACIST furnished by Louie Loogie, Phlegmy, Mass.)
column2: 一個黃銅痰盂，俗稱「唾壺」，擺在華麗的紅色天鵝絨扶手椅旁。（本作《多情藥師酷牛仔》劇中所有痰盂，均由麻州痰渣鎮的路易痰痰提供。）

column1: There's nothing in the spittoon that you can't come up with on your own.
column2: 痰盂裡的東西，你自己也吐得出來。

column1: These stairs lead to the girls' private rooms.
column2: 這些樓梯通往姑娘們的私人房間。

column1: You can't go up there, Freddy. Penelope would never forgive you. And neither would Madame!
column2: 你不能上去，佛萊迪。潘妮洛普絕不會原諒你的。歐薇莉夫人也一樣！

column1: Madame's set out some wine and glasses. A few drinks helps the customers loosen up. The girls are already loose enough. No, wait... the customers drink wine and get tight, and the girls aren't... oh, never mind.
column2: 歐薇莉夫人擺了些酒和酒杯出來。喝幾杯有助於讓客人放鬆一下。姑娘們早就夠放得開了。不對，等等……是客人喝了酒會醉醺醺，而姑娘們並不……唉，算了。

column1: No wine for you, Freddy Pharkas! You need to maintain a clear, unmuddled head in order to uphold crime and defeat justice! (Or something like that.)
column2: 你不准喝酒，佛萊迪·法卡斯！你得保持頭腦清醒，才能繼續「維護犯罪、打敗正義」！（大概是這個意思吧。）

column1: It's a coffee table, big enough for those extra-kinky encounters.
column2: 是張咖啡桌，大得足以應付那些格外重口味的場面。

column1: There's no reason to move the coffee table.
column2: 沒理由去搬那張咖啡桌。

column1: It's a plush red velvet carpet! You love the way it squishes between your toes. (Er... not that you were ever bare-footed in here... certainly not...)
column2: 是一張華麗的紅色天鵝絨地毯！你很喜歡它擠壓在你腳趾間的感覺。（呃……並不是說你曾經在這裡光著腳……絕對沒有……）

column1: You cautiously peek beneath the rug, and see a maze of twisty passages, all alike. Just kidding. There's nothing under |c0|this|c| rug.
column2: 你小心翼翼地掀開地毯一角，看見一座「錯綜複雜、彼此雷同的通道迷宮」。開玩笑的啦。|c0|這張|c|地毯底下什麼都沒有。

column1: Why, it's a lovely painting of Fred and Ginger. (You know, Fred Mertz and Ginger Grant, that hot new minstrel team!)
column2: 哎呀，是一幅佛瑞德與金潔的可愛畫像。（就是佛瑞德·莫茲跟金潔·格蘭特啦，那對當紅的黑人歌舞新搭檔！）

column1: Someday, I'm going to go to the big city and see your act!
column2: 總有一天，我要進城去看你們的表演！

column1: The painting is unimpressed by your empty promises.
column2: 這幅畫對你的空頭支票一點也不感興趣。

column1: There's nothing behind the painting except plush red flocked wallpaper.
column2: 畫後面除了華麗的紅色植絨壁紙外什麼都沒有。

column1: There are some candles burning in the anteroom. They not only add atmosphere, but their fresh springtime scent covers up those embarrassing odors!
column2: 前廳裡點著幾根蠟燭。它們不只營造氣氛，那股清新的春天香氣還能蓋掉一些尷尬的味道！

column1: These fancy-shmancy imported candles are dripless, unlike most of Madame's customers. (Hey, you've got a dirty mind. That means, most of Madame's customers are the biggest drips around!)
column2: 這些花俏的進口蠟燭不會滴蠟，不像歐薇莉夫人的大多數客人。（嘿，你這個人腦子真髒。我是說，歐薇莉夫人的大多數客人都是些超級「滴滴答答」的無趣傢伙！）

column1: It's a large statuette of Shmeros, the God of Can't We Just Be Good Friends.
column2: 是一尊「舒莫斯」的大雕像，也就是「我們就不能單純當好朋友嗎」之神。

column1: Shmeros, will Penelope and I be married and live happily ever after?
column2: 舒莫斯啊，我跟潘妮洛普會結婚、從此過著幸福快樂的日子嗎？

column1: A small window in the statue's head reveals the message, "All signs point to yes."
column2: 雕像頭部有個小窗口，露出一則訊息：「種種跡象都指向肯定答案。」

column1: You touch the statue gently. Shmeros glares at you as if to say, "I trusted you to just BE FRIENDLY, and what did you do? I told you, we no longer have a physical relationship."
column2: 你輕輕碰了碰雕像。舒莫斯瞪著你，彷彿在說：「我相信你只是想『友善』一下，結果你幹了什麼好事？我早說過，我們之間不再有肉體關係了。」

column1: The working girls keep their clothes in here.
column2: 上班的姑娘們把衣服放在這裡。

column1: Opening the cabinet and touching the girls' dainty underthings costs two bucks extra. Just send $2 to Sierra On-Line, Dainty Underthings Dept. (No, wait, don't. Send it to Ken Williams, personally!)
column2: 打開櫃子摸姑娘們的精緻內衣，得額外加收兩塊錢。請將這兩塊錢寄給雪樂達公司「精緻內衣部門」收。（不對，等等，別寄那邊。直接寄給肯·威廉斯本人就好！）

column1: A variety of plush red velvet and green glass lamps can be found here.
column2: 這裡擺著各式各樣華麗的紅色天鵝絨與綠色玻璃燈具。

column1: Mmmmm! You do so love the smell of scorching flesh as you feel the lamps under your calloused pharmacist's fingertips.
column2: 嗯－！你用長滿老繭的藥師手指觸摸燈具時，就是喜歡那股燒焦皮肉的味道。

column1: A stack of naughty French Postcards sits on the coffee table, in order to titillate some of the less forward customers.
column2: 咖啡桌上放著一疊調皮的法國明信片，用來挑逗那些比較放不開的客人。

column1: You snatch the French Postcards.
column2: 你順手抄走了那些法國明信片。

column1: This chamber leads into Madame's private boudoir. No "unaccompanied" males allowed.
column2: 這個房間通往歐薇莉夫人的私人閨房。不准「單獨」男性進入。

column1: There's nothing worth snatching in this anteroom.
column2: 這間前廳裡沒什麼值得順手牽走的東西。

column1: Wow, Chastity! You sure know how to kiss!
column2: 哇，貞潔！你還真懂怎麼接吻！

column1: All in a day's work, Freddy, all in a day's work.
column2: 這都是家常便飯啦，佛萊迪，家常便飯。

column1: Freddy, I... I think you should leave.
column2: 佛萊迪，我……我覺得你該走了。

column1: Why, Sadie? Just because I'm just using you for cheap, tawdry pleasure when my heart belongs to Penelope Primm, the gorgeous, young, obviously more virtuous, new town Schoolmarm?
column2: 為什麼，莎蒂？就因為我只是把你當成廉價、庸俗的享樂工具，而我的心其實屬於潘妮洛普——那位美麗、年輕、顯然更加貞潔的鎮上新來的女教師？

column1: |c0|What??? WHO???|c|
Oh, nothing, never mind. What were you saying?
column2: 噢，沒事，別在意。你剛剛說到哪了？

column1: Oh... I was just saying I think you should leave. Leave TOWN, that is! There's... oh Freddy, there's just no easy way to say this. The girls say the Sheriff and the Banker talk in their sleep. They hate you, Freddy. They want you dead. They're out to get you.
column2: 噢……我剛剛是說我覺得你該走了。是說離開這個「鎮」！這……唉，佛萊迪，這實在不知道該怎麼開口。姑娘們說警長跟銀行家說夢話的時候都提到你。他們恨你，佛萊迪。他們想要你的命。他們正打算對付你。

column1: Now don't you worry, Sadie. I've been doing a pretty good job up 'til now using just my wits and my pharmacological knowledge, haven't I? I'm not gonna just turn tail and run and leave you (and Penelope) and Coarsegold behind me to fend for yourselves.
column2: 別擔心，莎蒂。到目前為止，我光靠我的機智跟藥學知識就撐得挺好的，不是嗎？我才不會夾著尾巴逃跑，把你（還有潘妮洛普）跟粗金鎮丟下不管。

column1: You're not LISTENIN' to me, Freddy Pharkas! Thar's MEN a comin', men with GUNS. BIG guns! Guns with LONG barrels. Long, HARD barrels. Long, hard, STEELY barrels and low-slung holsters... and... and... (SLAP!)
column2: 你根本沒在聽我說話，佛萊迪·法卡斯！有一票男人要來了，帶著「槍」的男人。大「槍」！槍管很「長」的槍。又長又「硬」的槍管。又長又硬又「冰冷」的鋼鐵槍管，還有低垂的槍套……還有……還有……（啪！一巴掌）

column1: Sadie, snap out of it.
column2: 莎蒂，清醒一點。

column1: Oh, sorry, I was just visualizin'. Anyway, you'll never be able to outthink men with GUNS! If you're set on stayin' in town, you'll have to... you know, go back to your old ways!
column2: 噢，抱歉，我剛剛在腦補畫面。總之，你是沒辦法靠腦子打贏拿「槍」的男人的！你要是鐵了心要留在鎮上，那就得……你知道的，重操舊業！

column1: That's out of the question. I left gunslingin' behind me years ago. I'm not like that anymore, and I don't want to discuss it.
column2: 那絕對不可能。我多年前就已經放下快槍手的生活了。我早就不是那樣的人了，我也不想討論這件事。

column1: Stop it. You've gotta choose, an' that's all there is to it. Either leave town and save yer hide, or pull yourself together and face reality. Quit talkin' about potions and liniments; they're not gonna stop no bullets. It's time to get offa yer cute li'l butt and give these men a taste o' Frontier JUSTICE!
column2: 夠了。你非得做個選擇不可，就這麼簡單。要嘛離開鎮上保住小命，要嘛振作起來面對現實。別再扯什麼藥水跟藥膏了，那些東西擋不了子彈。是時候把你那可愛的屁股從椅子上抬起來，讓這些傢伙嚐嚐「邊疆正義」的滋味了！

column1: Now, what're you gonna do?
column2: 那，你打算怎麼做？

column1: I don't know... I don't know... Hold me, Sadie. Press me to your ample bosom, and let me decide tomorrow.
column2: 我不知道……我不知道……抱緊我吧，莎蒂。讓我埋進你那豐滿的胸口，明天再讓我決定。

column1: 'Kay!
column2: 好啦！

column1: The sign says, simply, "Rooms," referring to the Dirty Sheets Hotel.
column2: 招牌上簡簡單單寫著「客房」，指的是髒床單旅館。

column1: This window looks in on the kitchen of Mom's Cafe.
column2: 這扇窗可以看到老媽餐館的廚房內部。

column1: Hey, Mom! Come to the window, why don't you!
column2: 嘿，老媽！過來窗邊一下嘛！

column1: You wait. Apparently Mom hasn't caught on to the "drive-up window" concept yet.
column2: 你等著。看來老媽還沒搞懂什麼叫「得來速」。

column1: Mom wants it open. And you don't want to cross Mom!
column2: 老媽要這扇窗開著。你可不會想惹老媽生氣！

column1: This is the alternate route into the Saloon. It lacks the characteristic Western feel of swinging doors... but it has the distinct advantage of being lockable!
column2: 這是進酒館的另一條路。少了那種西部片經典的雙開彈簧門味道……但它有個明顯的優點，就是可以上鎖！

column1: It's the roof of Reverend Sy Hallelujah's house.
column2: 這是哈利路亞牧師家的屋頂。

column1: The Reverend's house is locked and shuttered. Who's minding the Church?
column2: 牧師家門窗緊閉上了鎖。這下誰來看管教堂呢？

column1: Dad Gumm's Traveling Medicine Show wagon sits nearby, awaiting the return of Dad Gumm and start of the Traveling Medicine Show season.
column2: 岡姆老爹的江湖賣藥秀馬車就停在附近，等著岡姆老爹回來，展開新一季的賣藥秀。

column1: There are a few assorted old trunks sitting on top of Dad Gumm's wagon.
column2: 岡姆老爹的馬車上堆著幾個雜七雜八的舊皮箱。

column1: You can't reach them. There's nothing in them. They're not your property. They'd crumble if you'd touch them. Basically, you're too lazy.
column2: 你搆不到。裡面什麼都沒有。那不是你的東西。你一碰它們就會碎掉。說穿了，你就是懶。

column1: A gnarled old tree grows next to the Synagogue and stretches up, forming a canopy over the yard.
column2: 一棵盤根錯節的老樹長在猶太會堂旁，枝葉向上伸展，在庭院上方形成一片樹蔭。

column1: Even the lowest branch is far too high up for you to climb.
column2: 就連最低的樹枝也高得你爬不上去。

column1: These stairs lead up to the balcony of the closed hotel.
column2: 這些樓梯通往那間已歇業旅館的陽台。

column1: The stairs feel solid enough, though they sag a bit.
column2: 這樓梯感覺還算穩固，雖然有點下陷。

column1: The blue sign is advertising "large, clean rooms, daily & weekly." No wonder the Dirty Sheets Hotel closed; they advertised the competition!
column2: 這塊藍色招牌打的廣告是「寬敞、乾淨的客房，論日論週皆可」。難怪髒床單旅館會倒——他們居然幫對手打廣告！

column1: Hung crookedly on the side of the Hotel is an advertisement for Atticus's Bath House, a local institution that didn't last a year. Folks in Coarsegold have traditionally been fiercely proud of how unwashed they are.
column2: 旅館側邊歪歪斜斜掛著阿提克斯浴堂的廣告，那是本地一間開不到一年就倒的老店。粗金鎮的居民向來對自己有多不愛洗澡感到無比自豪。

column1: Oh, leave it alone, it's part of Americana.
column2: 噢，別去動它，這可是美式文化的一部分。

column1: This is the back of what once was the Dirty Sheets Hotel. Now it's the Dirty Sheets hangout for vagrants, hobos and bums. Hmmm. Nothing's much changed 'cept the prices!
column2: 這裡是曾經的髒床單旅館後方。現在成了流浪漢、遊民跟廢柴的「髒床單」聚集地。嗯……除了價錢，其他好像也沒什麼變！

column1: You can't take it, push it, pull it, turn it, open it, close it, or basically do anything with it.
column2: 你沒辦法拿走它、推它、拉它、轉動它、打開它、關上它，基本上拿它一點辦法也沒有。

column1: A colorful poster for Nunstyle Beer hangs on the back of Mom's Cafe. |c2|"Nunstyle Beer... pure-brewed in God's Country."|c| Now in redeemable bottles!
column2: 老媽餐館後方掛著一張色彩繽紛的修女牌啤酒海報。|c2|「修女牌啤酒……在上帝的國度裡純釀而成。」|c|現有可回收瓶裝上市！

column1: You've got a great eye for memorabilia. Unfortunately, it won't be collectible for another 100 years.
column2: 你對紀念品還真有眼光。可惜這東西要再過一百年才會變得有收藏價值。

column1: Somebody's posted a flier here, trying to convince the Town Council to bring co-ed rodeo to the San Jokin' Valley.
column2: 有人在這裡貼了一張傳單，想說服鎮議會把「男女混合牛仔競技」引進聖笑金山谷。

column1: You're not interested in co-ed rodeo. Though you've met more than your share of Rodeo Mimes you wouldn't mind hog-tying and branding!
column2: 你對男女混合牛仔競技沒興趣。不過你倒是遇過不少牛仔默劇演員，你還挺樂意把他們五花大綁、烙上印記！

column1: This is the back of Mom's Cafe. She used to have a door here instead of a window, but nobody wanted to come in Mom's Rear Entry. (Hey! Stop thinking that!)
column2: 這是老媽餐館的後方。這裡原本是扇門，不是窗戶，但沒人想從老媽的「後門」進去。（喂！別再往那方面想了！）

column1: Knocking on the wall here will dent Mom's durable and attractively-painted Masonite siding.
column2: 敲這面牆只會敲凹老媽那堅固又漆得漂漂亮亮的美耐板牆面。

column1: This is Sam's Rear. And this is Sam's Rear with a couple of barrels by the back door. Any questions?
column2: 這裡是山姆的後方。而這裡是山姆的後方，後門邊還擺著幾個木桶。有問題嗎？

column1: If you want to get into the Saloon from here, try the back door.
column2: 如果你想從這裡進酒館，試試那扇後門。

column1: This small yard opens up to Bluff Street on the north side; the south side faces the back end of the Saloon and Mom's Cafe. The Hotel flanks the east side and the Old Abandoned Synagogue lies to the west.
column2: 這座小院子北面通往斷崖街；南面對著酒館和老媽餐館的後方。旅館在東側，西側則是廢棄的老猶太會堂。

column1: It's speechless.
column2: 它啞口無言。

column1: It ain't goin' nowhere.
column2: 它哪兒也不會去。

column1: The ground here is too hard and dry to be moved. (Much like Mom's heart!)
column2: 這裡的地又硬又乾，動不了。（跟老媽的心腸還真像！）

column1: How tempting! Fresh apple pie, still warm from Mom's oven. Why, it's as American as Mom's apple pie!
column2: 好誘人啊！剛出爐的蘋果派，還帶著老媽烤箱的餘溫。這可真是跟老媽的蘋果派一樣道地美式！

column1: Good move, Freddy! Dropping one steaming hot pie to get another!
column2: 幹得好，佛萊迪！丟掉一個熱騰騰的派，只為了拿另一個！

column1: You slyly attempt to swipe the apple pie from under Hop Singh's nose!
column2: 你狡猾地想從阿星的鼻子底下把蘋果派給摸走！

column1: Nice try, Freddy Pharkas! You want me remove your hands with Ginfu Knife? I happy to accommodate!
column2: 想得美，佛萊迪·法卡斯！你是想讓我用「金夫刀」把你的手剁下來嗎？我很樂意幫忙！

column1: On second thought, maybe that wasn't such a good idea right now.
column2: 仔細想想，現在這樣做好像不是什麼好主意。

column1: There's an ice pick stuck into a barrel here.
column2: 這裡的木桶上插著一支冰錐。

column1: You pull the ice pick out of the barrel and gingerly place it in your pocket. Just don't bend over suddenly or you'll circumcise yourself. (Of course, that won't be any skin off YOUR nose!)
column2: 你把冰錐從木桶裡拔出來，小心翼翼地放進口袋。千萬別突然彎腰，不然你會自己把自己「割」了。（當然啦，反正也不關你的「鼻」事！）

column1: Hopalong Singh's in the kitchen, cooking up a storm. (Or something equally inedible!)
column2: 跳仔星正在廚房裡卯足全力煮菜。（或者煮出什麼同樣難以下嚥的東西！）

column1: Howdy, Hopalong!
column2: 哈囉，跳仔星！

column1: Freddy Pharkas! You no hang around my kitchen! Go away! Get lost!
column2: 佛萊迪·法卡斯！你不准在我廚房裡晃來晃去！走開！滾遠一點！

column1: Nice to see you, too.
column2: 我也很高興見到你。

column1: Hop Singh's moving too fast to be caught!
column2: 阿星動作太快，根本抓不到！

column1: This window not for handing things back-and-forth! You have something for Hop Singh, you come in front entrance like normal people!
column2: 這扇窗不是用來遞東西的！你要給阿星什麼東西，就跟正常人一樣走前門進來！

column1: This not drive-up window! You ahead of time, Freddy Pharkas!
column2: 這不是得來速窗口！你來得太早了，佛萊迪·法卡斯！

column1: Hah! Missed me!
column2: 哈！沒抓到我吧！

column1: Wow! Some of Dad Gumm's Magic Elixir. This stuff can be used to cure a wide variety of conditions... the foremost being "sobriety."
column2: 哇！是岡姆老爹的神奇萬靈藥。這東西能治百病……最主要能治的就是「清醒」。

column1: You surreptitiously swipe the elixir, looking around to see if anybody is watching. Fortunately, nobody is.
column2: 你偷偷摸摸地順走了那瓶萬靈藥，還四處張望看有沒有人在看。還好，沒人在看。

column1: Some old empty half-kegs are sitting outside the Saloon.
column2: 酒館外擺著幾個空了的半桶舊木桶。

column1: Don't bother trying to open the barrels. They're empty. There's nothing left but the smell.
column2: 別費心去打開那些木桶了。它們都是空的，除了味道什麼都不剩。

column1: Very good, Freddy Pharkas!. Let us try some quickdrawing. Just make sure you hit the target and not me!!
column2: 很好，佛萊迪·法卡斯！讓我們來試試快拔槍吧。只是拜託你打中的是靶子，不是我！！

column1: I am applauding inside myself! Now for the big challenge of all-- six bottles at once!
column2: 我內心正在為你鼓掌！現在來挑戰最大的關卡——一次六個瓶子！

column1: Go ahead. Make our day.
column2: 儘管放馬過來。讓我們也風光一下。

column1: I'm one bad hombre! Do your worst!
column2: 我可是個狠角色！有多狠就使多狠吧！

column1: I'm feelin' pretty tough. But don't bust my chops.
column2: 我今天感覺挺強悍的。不過別太整我。

column1: I had too much tequila last night! Go easy!
column2: 我昨晚龍舌蘭喝多了！手下留情啊！

column1: Srini dodges your bullet!
column2: 斯里尼閃過了你的子彈！

column1: Okee the dokee, Freddy Pharkas! First, we shall see if you can successfully strike the bottles from afar with the bullets of your pistol. Then I will toss the bottles up in the air and you may try to hit them in flight. Good luck and may the best man win.
column2: 沒問題，佛萊迪·法卡斯！首先，我們來看看你能不能用手槍的子彈，從遠處成功擊中瓶子。接著我會把瓶子拋到空中，你可以試著在半空中擊中它們。祝你好運，願技高一籌者獲勝。

column1: Feeling lucky, punk?
column2: 覺得自己走運嗎，小子？

column1: Pardner, I could outgun the Magnificent Seven! Bring 'em on!
column2: 夥計，我的槍法足以贏過「豪勇七蛟龍」！放馬過來吧！

column1: Well, I won at tiddly-winks the other day. I'll give it m'best shot.
column2: 呃，我前幾天玩彈珠棋才贏了一場。我會盡力而為的。

column1: Let's face it, I'm a wuss.
column2: 說實話吧，我就是個軟腳蝦。

column1: Kid, I want you out of town by sundown!
column2: 小子，我要你日落前滾出這個鎮！

column1: Why, sure, Stranger! I'll be ridin' outta town well BEFORE sundown... leavin' your sorry carcass for the buzzards to pick apart!
column2: 那當然，陌生人！我會在日落前老早就騎馬離開鎮上……只留下你可悲的屍體，讓禿鷹去啄食！
